name: Sticky Greeter AP OLD
description: A taxidermy giant spider's abdomen opens up to spray the area in front of it with sticky webbing.
disable: DC 23 Thievery to disable the pressure plate that triggers the sticky greeter.
reset: The sticky greeters must be reset manually.

defensiveAbilities.name: Web
defensiveAbilities.description:
Web Hardness 5

Web HP 20

Immunities bludgeoning damage, critical hits, object immunities, piercing damage, precision damage

offensiveAbilities.name: Spray Webbing
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps on the pressure plate adjacent to the sticky greeter

Effect The sticky greeter lurches as its abdomen snaps forward, opens, and sprays the triggering creature with thick sheets of alchemical webbing. At the same time, the sticky greeter emits a high-pitched whistling sound. The creature must make a DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save or become Immobilized and held in place, or Restrained on a critical failure until it Escapes or the webbing binding it is destroyed.
